entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.
entries.uk: А, точно, сьогодні ж День святого[n]Валентина. То ось чому сюди стільки[n]хлопців із дівчатами приходило.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.
entries.uk: А в тебе що, нічого цікавого[n]не намічається? Ти ж тут уже[n]майже рік.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...
entries.uk: От коли я був молодий, ого-го...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Good evening...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ms. Kawakami...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: A teacher and her student... So this[n]sort of thing really does happen, huh?
entries.uk: Учителька та її учень... То таке[n]й справді буває, га?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hello.
Have a seat.[clr 27]
I'll make you some coffee.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's been a while since I was here last.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Would you prefer that I wear my maid[n]outfit?
entries.uk: Може, мені краще вбратися[n]в костюм покоївки?

entries.en: I'll be expecting it next time.
You're fine the way you are.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Fiiine.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Really? That makes me sad, Master...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, before I forget...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I went through the trouble of buying[n]a microwave oven just to make it,[n]you know.
entries.uk: Я, між іншим, спеціально купила[n]мікрохвильовку, тільки щоб[n]його приготувати.

entries.en: I really appreciate it.[clr 27]
This is incredible.[clr 27]
Is this part of your maid work?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, I like your honesty.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Shall I serve it to you as a reward?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Nope. This is completely on my[n]personal time.
entries.uk: Ні. Це суто мій особистий час.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Welcome back, Master.
Master's home.[clr 27]
Are you doing okay?
I've missed you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Good.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We're so busy preparing for graduation[n]and entrance ceremonies...
entries.uk: Ми так закрутилися з підготовкою[n]до випускного й церемонії вступу...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...That I don't have time to think[n]about that.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Me too.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: When I heard from Sakura-san that you[n]turned yourself in, I cried.
entries.uk: Коли я почула від Сакури-сана,[n]що ти здався поліції, я плакала.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...You really are a problem child.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Tell me the truth, do you... regret being in[n]a relationship with me?
entries.uk: Скажи чесно, ти... шкодуєш,[n]що в тебе стосунки зі мною?

entries.en: I don't regret it.[clr 27]
Do you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm happy to hear that...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Did you respond to my question with[n]a question? You get a zero on this quiz.
entries.uk: Ти відповів питанням на питання?[n]За цю контрольну в тебе нуль.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You're going back home next month?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That means we won't be able to see each[n]other at school anymore...
entries.uk: Отже, ми більше не зможемо[n]бачитися в школі...

entries.en: What should we do?
It's going to get lonely.
We don't have to hide anymore.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Maybe you can stay... Sorry, I know that's[n]probably not gonna happen.
entries.uk: Може, ти б лишився... Вибач, я знаю,[n]що це навряд чи можливо.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We used to be able to see each other[n]every day in homeroom...
entries.uk: Раніше ми могли бачитися щодня[n]на класній годині...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: In terms of status, yes. But...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm the adult here, so... it'll be okay.[n]I'll think of something.
entries.uk: Я тут доросла, тож... усе буде добре.[n]Я щось придумаю.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I waited all this time for you to get[n]discharged, so there's nothing that[n]can deter me now.
entries.uk: Я весь цей час чекала, доки тебе[n]випустять, тож тепер мене ніщо[n]не зупинить.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Tonight, you're going to listen to[n]my needs.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And I'm not gonna let you be lazy[n]about it...
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Kawakami...
